hos_pilgrim.name: Hollow Pilgrim
hos_pilgrim.desc: A traveller in a grey road-cloak, walking the cloister in slow circles with an unlit lamp held out before it. It has been arriving at the Hospice for fifty years.

moves.name: Plod On
moves.tell: draws its cloak tight and lowers its head

hos_waymoth.name: Waylamp Moth
hos_waymoth.desc: A grey moth as broad as a hand, its wings printed with a tiny brass lamp. It drifts to any flame it finds, looking for the one it was bound to.

moves.name: Scale Dust
moves.tell: beats its wings, shedding grey scales

hos_almoner.name: Brother Odran the Almoner
hos_almoner.desc: The Hospice's almoner, thin and courteous, in an apron stained with fifty years of soup. He carries a wooden alms-bowl and is still laying places for guests.

hos_vesper.name: The Vesper Moth
hos_vesper.desc: A moth the size of a sail, grey as a cold lamp, with a pale brass mark on each wing where a lamp was. She was the saint's own, and she has been looking for her light ever since.

moves.name: Scale Dust
moves.tell: shakes the rafters with a wingbeat; grey scales fall

moves.name: Drink the Flame
moves.tell: turns her face to your lantern

phases.msg: She is looking, not at you, but at the empty hook above the gate she can see through the wall.
